product_family: Dagster: AI-native DataOps orchestration platform with open-source core (Dagster), cloud SaaS (Dagster+), and hybrid/serverless deployment options. Key modules: data orchestration, asset-based pipelines, data catalog, data quality, cost insights, and Compass (AI-assisted workflows).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I
certifications.proof_quote: Elementl announced SOC 2 Type I compliance in July 2022: 'SOC 2 Type I is just the first step and we've already started our SOC 2 Type II audit.'

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type II report proves our commitment to security as we aim to keep our customer data secure. (Audit reports available on request to trustcenter@dagsterlabs.com, per the security page.)

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: In order to handle the most sensitive types of customer information, Dagster Labs (the company behind Dagster) states it is HIPAA compliant to secure Protected Health Information. The security page states HIPAA compliance but does not mention a Business Associate Agreement; BAA availability is not publicly documented.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: No explicit GDPR compliance statement or Data Processing Agreement found on the dagster.io domain. Neither the security page nor the privacy policy mentions GDPR or a DPA. Dagster+ does offer EU data residency ('With Dagster+ EU, your control plane, metadata, and operational data reside in European data centers'; deployments placed in the eu-north-1 region), but data residency is not a GDPR compliance attestation.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found despite vendor domain search. No mention in security pages, trust documentation, or compliance materials.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. Not mentioned in security pages or compliance materials.

privacy.ai_training_note: The privacy policy makes no explicit mention of AI model training on customer data, and no opt-out clause was found; the status is unclear.
privacy.data_region: US (default); EU region (eu-north-1) available for Dagster+ control plane and metadata. Hybrid deployments keep customer data on-premises in customer infrastructure.

security.name: Data Encryption in Transit
security.value: HTTPS required for all inbound requests to Dagster+ (security page states 'All inbound network requests to Dagster+ require HTTPS'; specific TLS version not publicly documented)

security.name: Data Encryption at Rest
security.value: All data stored persistently in Postgres, Redis, and S3 is encrypted at rest (security page states data 'are encrypted at rest'; specific cipher/key length not publicly documented)

security.name: Risk Management
security.value: Annual risk assessments, network penetration tests, and Dagster+ penetration testing conducted regularly

security.name: Incident Response
security.value: Formal incident response policy with employee-initiated security incident reporting

security.name: Physical Security
security.value: AWS hosts all infrastructure; no employee access to AWS data centers; offices do not store customer information

security.name: Vulnerability Disclosure Program
security.value: Operates responsible disclosure program for security researchers

security.name: Audit Access
security.value: SOC 2 reports and penetration test documentation available upon request to customers and partners. Contact: trustcenter@dagsterlabs.com

products.name: Dagster (Open Source)
products.data_scope: Runs in customer infrastructure; no data transmitted to vendor unless explicitly configured
products.notes: Free, open-source Python framework for data orchestration. Community-driven with active development. Self-hosted only (no vendor data processing unless Dagster+ integration enabled).

products.name: Dagster+ Serverless
products.data_scope: Control plane and metadata reside in Dagster-managed AWS (US or EU region); actual data processing occurs in customer code. The default I/O manager stores data in Dagster-managed storage, so custom I/O managers are required for PII/PHI/GDPR data.
products.notes: Fully managed cloud deployment. Enforces data residency via EU region (eu-north-1). Requires careful configuration for regulated data.

products.name: Dagster+ Hybrid
products.data_scope: Control plane in Dagster-managed AWS. Customer code and data remain in customer infrastructure (cloud, on-premises, or hybrid). Metadata and operational data only sent to Dagster+.
products.notes: Recommended for regulated data and compliance-sensitive deployments. Supports multi-region failover. EU region available.

products.name: Dagster+ Enterprise
products.data_scope: Same as Hybrid; adds enterprise features, branch deployments, and governance
products.notes: Adds advanced access control, branch deployments, and dedicated support. The vendor states HIPAA compliance on its security page, but BAA availability is not publicly documented. Available in US and EU regions.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (open-source) + SaaS subscription (Dagster+) with usage-based and enterprise tiers
compare.data_residency: US (default AWS) or EU (eu-north-1). Hybrid/on-prem deployments keep customer data on-premises.
top_certs: SOC 2 Type II (vendor states on security page; audit completion date/scope not public)
HIPAA (vendor states HIPAA compliant; BAA availability not publicly documented)
EU data residency available (eu-north-1); no public GDPR attestation or DPA

flags: SOC 2 Type II completion date is not public. A blog post from July 2022 confirmed Type I and stated Type II was 'in progress.' Later pages state Type II is certified, but no audit completion date or scope details are publicly documented. Audit reports can be requested from trustcenter@dagsterlabs.com.

GDPR compliance is not substantiated on the vendor domain: no GDPR compliance statement appears on the security page or privacy policy, and no public DPA (standard template or available on request) was found. EU data residency (the eu-north-1 region, for control plane, metadata, and operational data) is documented, but this is not itself a GDPR attestation.
Privacy policy US-centric: primary privacy policy is US-focused with limited GDPR-specific language. No explicit GDPR rights articulation (right to access, erasure, portability, etc.).

Serverless deployment risk for regulated data: default I/O manager stores data in Dagster-managed S3; users working with PII/PHI/GDPR data must explicitly configure custom I/O managers. Risk of misconfiguration.
The privacy policy does not address whether Dagster+ uses customer data (orchestration context, lineage, failures) to train Dagster+ AI features; the status is unclear.
No ISO 27001 certification: despite enterprise positioning and SOC 2 certification, no ISO 27001 certification found. This is common for SaaS vendors but notable for compliance-sensitive customers.
Audit reports require direct request: SOC 2 reports not publicly available; must be requested from trustcenter@dagsterlabs.com. This is standard practice but limits transparent verification.
